text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Hak Cipta
(Entiti yang Diberi Kuasa) (Pindaan) 2023.

(2)  Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 29 September 2023.

Penggantian Jadual

2. Perintah Hak Cipta (Entiti yang Diberi Kuasa) 2022 [P.U. (A) 220/2022 ]
dipinda dengan menggantikan Jadual dengan jadual yang berikut:

"JADUAL
[Perenggan 2]

text.en: 3. Persatuan Orang-Orang Cacat Penglihatan Islam Malaysia

4. St. Nicholas' Home, Penang".

Dibuat 27 September 2023
[KPDNKK.100-1/4/17; PN(PU2)457/V]

                                                             DATUK ARMIZAN BIN MOHD ALI
                                                               Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri dan Kos Sara Hidup

COPYRIGHT ACT 1987

COPYRIGHT (AUTHORIZED ENTITY) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2023

IN exercise of the  powers conferred by subsection 13 (2C) of the Copyright Act 1987
[Act 332], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Copyright (Authorized Entity)
(Amendment) Order 2023.

(2)  This Order comes into operation on 29 September 2023.

Substitution of Schedule
2. The Copyright (Authorized Entity) Order 202 2 [P.U. (A) 220/2022 ] is amended
by substituting for the Schedule the following schedule:

"SCHEDULE
[Paragraph 2]

1. Malaysian Association for the Blind
2. National Library of Malaysia
3. Persatuan Orang-Orang Cacat Penglihatan Islam Malaysia
4. St. Nicholas' Home, Penang".

Made 27 September 2023
[KPDNKK.100-1/4/17; PN(PU2)457/V]

                                                                             DATUK ARMIZAN BIN MOHD ALI
                                                                                     Minister of Domestic Trade and Cost of Living
